title: Cortex RefinePunchupResponse (DRAFT v0)
description: The 2xx success body returned by the refine-punchup gate. Per ADR-0014, authored once in cortex/contracts/ and imported by every consumer. Surfaces-Builder is the named consumer; agent-fabric's in-process engine is the named producer (ADR-0023). Status: DRAFT v0. v0→v1 promotion gated on a real end-to-end round-trip through the engine. Per punch-up standard §0.7, the gate emits THREE success outcomes: ready (clean + small + verifiable), clarify (low confidence or unresolved architecture concern), decompose (multi-deliverable, creates children that re-enter the gate). Transport errors (4xx/5xx/timeout) are OUT-OF-BAND with a separate shape; see refine-punchup-request for context.

status.description: The punch-up gate's success decision. Per punch-up standard §0.7: ready (clean + small + verifiable), clarify (low confidence or architecture concern, route back to surface), decompose (multi-deliverable, children re-enter the gate with project scope inherited). decompose is a happy-path outcome, NOT a variant of error.

envelope.description: The TaskEnvelope after the gate. On status:ready, envelope.refined_prompt + envelope.acceptance_criteria are populated. On status:clarify, envelope.clarification is populated. On status:decompose, the spine has created children with the original id as parent_id. Permissive on additional properties (additionalProperties: true) for the same reason as the request envelope: real envelopes have ~26 fields beyond the canonical TaskEnvelope's 25; the inlined subset here is the minimum the response needs to communicate. The server MUST return envelopes with additional fields when they're set on the post-punchup envelope. v1 design question: should the canonical TaskEnvelope schema also be loosened? Separate ADR conversation.

clarification.description: Present on status:clarify. The question the gate wants answered. clarification_id is the AF :3333 clarifications row id (optional).

parent_id.description: Present on status:decompose. The new parent id of the children the spine has just created. Children re-enter the punch-up gate with project scope inherited.
